name: Contra Costa 4-H Youth Development Program
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects to work on during the year. Most meetings and activities are from August through May.
who_can_apply: Youth who are 9 by December 31 of the program year and have not turned 19 by that date can join as regular members. Younger children can join as Primary Members.
pay_detail: $150 per youth. Financial help is available for youth members.
duration: Program year runs July 1 to June 30; most meetings are August to May
deadline_text: Youth enrollment opened Aug 3, 2026 for the 2026-2027 program year. The page gives no closing date.
how_to_apply: Find a club near you by place and meeting time. Contact the club leader. Then enroll online in the 4-H system linked on the page, or call the County 4-H Office for help. Pick your projects and pay the fee.
notes: Adults who want to volunteer enroll too. Their fee is $30. Adult enrollment opened July 15, 2026. Open the page in a browser to see the club list and the enrollment links.
